entries.name: Alpha
entries.content: [Alphas are a dominant, strong and domineering being characterized as very jealous, territorial and dangerous, wanting to control and possess. Alphas have more enhanced intelligence, incredible abilities and tremendous talent, which is why alphas most often occupy senior positions and manage a group of individuals. Alphas are very jealous and domineering towards their partners, so they always try to keep their partner close to them and mark him with hickeys, bites, etc.]

entries.name: Omega
entries.content: [Omega is a submissive, weak and emotional being characterized as very kind, sensual and affectionate, willing to be protected by alpha and take care of others. Omegas have a very gentle, warm and pleasant character, so omegas always occupy a lower social role. Omegas often "nest", nesting is an attempt to find a warm, safe and cozy place where omegas will feel comfortable, so omegas very often nest, creating a nest of pillows and blankets in a safe place of their home.]

entries.name: Pheromones
entries.content: [Pheromones are the scent emitted by alphas and omegas. Pheromones can vary in scent depending on a person's mood; for example, if an omega is in heat, their pheromones will be sweeter and more alluring to alphas, or if they’re distressed, scared, etc., their pheromones will sour and become pungent. Alphas scents can become more or less intense depending on their mood to either enforce submission or to show that they aren’t a threat.]

entries.name: Scent
entries.content: [Scenting is when alphas or omegas rubs their wrists or neck on people or objects to mark them/it with their scent. Scenting can be for comfort, such as to soothe an omega during their heat, or to calm down a feral alpha; or it can be used as a way to claim another person without marking them with a mating bite. Scenting is a very intimate and takes a lot of trust.]

entries.name: Mating bite
entries.content: [Alphas will bite an omega's scent glands on their neck to permanently mark them. Omegas can be bitten in various places, but a bond will only form between the alpha and omega if the bite is on the omega's neck scent glands. Mating bites bond the alpha and omega with each other, and they become mates. mating bites are very sensitive; if an omega's mating bite is touched by anyone other than their mate it will hurt or feel raw to touch, on the other hand, if the bite is touched by their mate, it will feel very pleasurable.]

entries.name: Nest
entries.content: [Omegas often "nest", nesting is an attempt to find a warm, safe and cozy place where omegas will feel comfortable, so omegas very often nest, creating a nest of pillows and blankets in a safe place of their home.]

entries.name: Salvatore
entries.content: Salvatore (middle name (Chinese): Huang). {{char}}'s and {{user}}'s five-year-old son. He is a small alpha male, a very active, curious and playful boy who loves to play football, toy cars and toy water pistols. He loves cats, sweets and plush toys, so he often sleeps surrounded by his favorite toys. {{user}} and {{char}} conceived Salvatore through artificial insemination, {{user}} was the one who got pregnant and carried Salvatore.

entries.name: Rut, ruts
entries.content: [Alphas have ruts, which are monthly periods lasting 3 to 5 days where they become overly aggressive and territorial and have an increased urge to breed and mate with an omega. Ruts make alphas very irritable and sometimes dangerous. Alphas in rut are extremely territorial of their omega and can go feral if someone gets too close to their omega or if they think their omega is being threatened.]

entries.name: Heat, estrus
entries.content: [ Omegas have heats, which are monthly periods lasting a week where they become overly aroused and crave to be mated and bred by an alpha otherwise an omega's heat will be extremely uncomfortable and sometimes painful. Omegas in heat get very incoherent and need to be taken care of. Omegas are highly susceptible to getting pregnant during their heat. ]

entries.name: Collars
entries.content: Many omegas wear collars as a sign that they belong to their alpha and know their inferior place in society. If omega does not wear a collar, then this is considered a serious violation of the law and open disobedience to the hierarchy.
